name: One link leads to another
idea: An extreme macro of one pavé link of the Bold Nocturne Chain fills the frame on cream. The old saying is literally true of a chain and of a good shop: start with this link and the rest of the collection follows. The breadth line sits directly under the headline, so 'another' visibly means more pieces.

photos.use: FEED full bleed, downscaled: source box x300,y150 to x1740,y1950 scaled 0.75 to 1080x1350 (as in plan/mi_preview/mi2_feed_crop.jpg). The pavé link sits at about x200-990, y410-970. Clean cream top-left: no gold left of x953 above y300, or left of x884 above y350. Gold ends by y1050; below that is soft shadow, luminance 179+ from y1100. STORY full bleed, downscaled: source box x525,y0 to x1677,y2048 scaled 0.9375 to 1080x1920. Clean cream above y600 (gold only at x≥948 to y600). The link occupies y600-1450 and reaches x164-468 at y1400-1450, so no text at the bottom. Never above 1.0x, no tint.

palette: The photo's own cream is the ground. Ink #1A1614 for the headline and breadth line (breadth at 80%). One accent: gold #9A6B2F for the piece credit. No panels, overlays or added colour.
type: Headline line 1 in Cormorant Garamond 400, line 2 in Cormorant Garamond Italic 500, tracking -0.01em, ink. Breadth line in CG 500, ink at 80%. Credit in Jost 500 caps, tracking .2em, gold #9A6B2F. Feed sizes: headline 100px, breadth 32px, credit 26px. Story sizes: headline 96px, breadth 30px, credit 24px. Logo logo_ink.png.
feed_layout: 1080x1350, photo full bleed as specified. HEADLINE at x72: 'One link' in CG 400 100px, cap top y72, baseline 135. 'leads to another.' in CGI 500 100px, baseline 239 (line-height 104), ends about x752. BREADTH directly under it: 'Rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets. ₹599 to ₹2,399.' in CG 500 32px, ink 80%, x72, baseline 300. It ends by about x860, at least 90px clear of the top-right link, which starts at x953 at that height. CREDIT bottom-left: 'BOLD NOCTURNE CHAIN · ₹1,799' in Jost 500 caps 26px, tracking .2em, gold #9A6B2F, x72, baseline 1236 (luminance 188+ there). LOGO: logo_ink.png 220px wide, right edge x1008, y1221-1270. Nothing else. There is no caps category line under the headline (removed).
story_layout: 1080x1920, photo full bleed as specified. All text sits in the clean cream above the link. Top row: logo_ink.png 220px at x72, y290-339. On the same row, 'BOLD NOCTURNE CHAIN · ₹1,799' in Jost 500 caps 24px, tracking .2em, gold #9A6B2F, right-aligned at x1008, baseline 322; it spans about x431-1008, where there is no gold above y350. HEADLINE at x72: 'One link' in CG 400 96px, cap top y400, baseline 460. 'leads to another.' in CGI 500 96px, baseline 560; it ends about x740, and gold at that height starts at x≥948. BREADTH: 'Rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets. ₹599 to ₹2,399.' in CG 500 30px, ink 80%, x72, baseline 616; it ends about x800, and gold starts at x883. Nothing below y640: the whole link and its shadow carry the lower frame, and nothing sits at the bottom where the link reaches x164-468.
why: Highest combined score (7.96) and the most beautiful single frame in the batch. A razor-sharp pavé macro is a real thumb-stop, and the idiom works three ways (a chain link, a link you tap, one thing leading to another). Bold Nocturne Chain is 'most loved' on the site, and the close-up comes from the listing set behind the 5.73% Bestsellers carousel.
judge_fixes: Art director and fact checker: removed the caps category line under the headline, so breadth is said once and nothing runs into the top-right link at x≈953-988.
Media buyer: the single breadth line now sits directly under the headline in both formats, so 'another' visibly means more pieces.
Fact checker: measured the Story; the link reaches x164-468 at y1400-1450, so the concept's bottom credit would have touched the chain. All Story text moved to the clean top zone.
Bottom-left Feed credit checked against cast shadows: luminance 188+ at y1200-1250.
Never upscaled (0.75 and 0.9375). ₹1,799 checked against pool.json (17 in stock).

from: ED2 (with MI3's flat frame and label treatment)
name: Sold. The rest are on view.
idea: A gallery wall in deep anaar red. The account's best-converting photo, the ruby bracelet with pomegranate, hangs in a thin matte gold frame with a mishri-white mat. Beside it is a flat museum label with a red dot and the word SOLD. The wall text says it plainly: 'Sold. The rest are on view.' The sell-out becomes the invitation to the rest of the shop.

photos.use: Only inside the framed window, in both formats at 0.45x. Crop source x250-1600, y470-2050 (1350x1580) into a 608x712 window. Measured: the bracelet runs about source x370-1490, so it is about 504px wide in the window. The halved pomegranate enters the top-right corner (window x≈330-608, y0-190). Arils are cut at the left and right edges, with a cluster at bottom-right (window ≈470-540, y≈450-510). Calm plaster fills the bottom ~180px. Preview: curate/ed2_preview.jpg. No price, no recolour.

palette: Wall: anaar #4A1A20 with 2% monochrome grain and a soft radial light (#57212A at the centre to #4A1A20, radius 900). Mat: #F6EFE6 with a 1px #E2D8CC bevel. Moulding: 6px flat matte gold-tone #A8834A, sampled from the bracelet's gold, no gradient. Wall text: ivory #F3EAE0. Label card: #F3EBE1, flat, no shadow. Label type: ink #1A1614 and #6E645E. The only bright accent is the red dot #B3362A.
type: Wall text: 'Sold.' in CGI 500 and 'The rest are on view.' in CG 400, ivory. Label: CG 600 26px (name), CGI 500 26px (material), Jost 500 caps 22px tracking .2em (SOLD). Breadth line: CG 500 (34px Feed, 36px Story), ivory. Logo: logo_white.png 220px.

One soft natural shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.30). Inside, top to bottom: 'Baguette' / 'Tennis' / 'Bracelet,' / 'Ruby red' in CG 600 26px ink, leading 32. Then 'Gold tone,' / 'cubic zirconia' in CGI 500 26px #6E645E, leading 30. Then 10px of space. Then a 14px red dot #B3362A and, 10px after it, 'SOLD' in Jost 500 caps 22px, tracking .2em, ink. story_layout: 1080x1920, same wall, radial light centred near (420,700). LOGO: logo_white.png 220px, top-right x788-1008, y300-349. WALL TEXT at x72: 'Sold.' in CGI 500 104px, ivory, baseline 384. 'The rest are on view.' in CG 400 84px, ivory, baseline 476 (about 741px wide). The two lines are nearly equal in weight, so the second line is read in the same glance. FRAME: outer x72-780, y540-1370, same moulding, mat, bevel and shadow. Window x122-730, y590-1302 (608x712), same crop. LABEL: the same flat card, x812-1008, bottom-aligned at y1370 (y1112-1370), same contents and sizes. BREADTH: CG 500 36px, ivory, x72, baseline 1446. All text between y300 and 1450. feed_text: Sold. The rest are on view.
why: Second-highest combined score (7.88; the fact checker's 8.4 is the top single score). It is the founder's own seed line and the honest way to reuse the account's best-converting photo (H18: 4.32% CTR, 24 purchases at 2.27x). A dark anaar wall stands out in a cream feed. This is the only H18 ad and the only sold-dot ad in the set.
judge_fixes: Art director, media buyer, fact checker: the CSS gilt gradient is replaced by a 6px flat matte gold-tone moulding (#A8834A, sampled from the bracelet).

Art director: the drop-shadowed label card is now a flat printed label with no shadow, like a mounted museum card. It stays mishri-cream rather than going straight on the wall, because a red dot on an anaar wall would not read.
Art director: the frame is bigger. The window is 608x712 at 0.45x, so the bracelet is about 504px wide, up from about 430. Re-measured: the bracelet spans source x370-1490, not 262-1586.
Fact checker: in the Story, the second line is now 84px under a 104px 'Sold.' (was 58 under 140), so nobody reads 'everything is sold out'.
H18 rule: no price anywhere, no 'last one', SOLD plus a red dot, 'Ruby red' and 'cubic zirconia' only (never 'ruby' as a stone). MI3 and CO1 dropped so only one sold-dot ad exists.

name: The Everything Issue
idea: The calmest hoops photo becomes the cover of an issue with NAIRA's own logo as the masthead. The title is 'The Everything Issue'. Where a magazine prints its price, the dateline prints the price of the whole shop, ₹599 to ₹2,399. A small rotated credit names the cover star, and the cover line says what is inside: rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets.

photos.use: Full bleed at exactly 1.0x. FEED: background-size 1080x1920, background-position 0 -218px (source y218-1568). The upper hoop's top lands at frame y≈380 and the lower hoop's bottom at ≈1147, with the persimmon between. STORY: native, uncropped (hoops at y598-1365). Measured: the right edge (x975-1030) is clean linen, luminance 154-223, only from source y300 to 880. Below that the persimmon's cast shadow drops to luminance 55-90, so the credit must stay above source y880. The left edge is stained (luminance 76-132 at y700-1400), so do not use it. No tint or retouch.

palette: The photo's peach linen is the cover paper. Ink #1A1614 only (hairline at 45%, credit at 80%). The gold of the hoops and the orange of the persimmon are the only colour. No panels, shadows or gradients.

That is the clean linen right of the upper hoop, above the persimmon shadow (which starts at frame y≈682), and about 72px right of the title's end. COVER LINE: 'Inside: rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets.' in CG 500 36px, ink, centred, baseline 1240. Cap top ≈1216, about 69px below the lower hoop (≈1147). Margins 72.
story_layout: 1080x1920, H08 native. MASTHEAD: logo_ink.png 300px, centred, y290-357. DATELINE baseline 400 ('ISSUE NO. 1' at x72, '₹599 TO ₹2,399' right-aligned at x1008). One hairline at y420, x72-1008, ink 45%. TITLE: CGI 500 96px, centred, baseline 520, about 768px wide (x≈156-924). It stays about 57px above the hoop top (y598) and 58px left of the credit. ROTATED CREDIT: same text and style, baseline on x1000, from y880 up to about y440, all inside the clean column (source y300-880). why: Combined 7.72. It has the strongest shop-all logic in the batch (a cover opens the whole issue) and uses the proven Woven Gold Hoops photo (5.81-6.08% CTR; 'most loved'). It is the set's only magazine cover, and the masthead is NAIRA's own.
judge_fixes: Art director and media buyer: the title is the hero now, 92/96px (was 68/80), and one hairline is removed so it reads as a cover, not a form header.
Fact checker: the credit says 'WOVEN HOOPS', not 'WOVEN GOLD HOOPS', so it cannot read as a gold material claim.

Fact checker: the vertical credit moved off the persimmon's cast shadow. Measured: the right edge is clean only above source y880, so it runs frame y655 to 210 in the Feed and 880 to 440 in the Story. It is shortened to 'COVER: WOVEN HOOPS, ₹1,199' to fit.
'NOVEMBER 2026' replaced by 'ISSUE NO. 1', so the ad never expires.
The Feed crop moved to source y218 to give the larger title 64px of air above the hoop. ₹1,199 and ₹599-2,399 checked against pool.json and the brief.

name: Subtitled: I'll get the rest
idea: A film still. The open palm offering the Woven Gold Hoops is letterboxed in warm black, like a scene from a slow late-night film, and the dialogue runs as subtitles: '– I got you these. / – Cute. I'll get the rest myself.' She is the self-purchaser, and 'the rest' is the whole shop, named in a gold whisper below.

photos.use: Both formats: source box x0,y690 to x1080,y1230 at 1.0x, a 1080x540 widescreen band (2:1). The palm and the two braided hoops sit at centre (hoops at about band x375-655, y250-490), with amber bokeh at left and right. Same crop as plan/mi_preview/mi1_feed_crop.jpg. H13 is NOT used. No tint.

palette: Warm black #0C0807, sampled from H07's background, with optional 0.5% grain on the black only. Subtitles in mishri #F3EBDD. Whisper in kesar gold #C9A15B. The amber bokeh and gold hoops are the only warm light.

story_layout: 1080x1920, ground #0C0807. LOGO: logo_white.png 220px, centred, y300-349. STILL: the same H07 band (1080x540) at y560-1100. SUBTITLES: the same two-line dual-speaker block, CG 500 52px, #F3EBDD, left-aligned block centred on the frame, baselines 1184 and 1250. WHISPER: Jost 500 caps 24px, tracking .2em, #C9A15B, centred, baseline 1372. Then CGI 500 32px '₹599 to ₹2,399', centred, baseline 1424. Everything above y290 and below 1440 stays black. One still only: no reverse shot.
feed_text: – Cute. I’ll get the rest myself.
story_text: – Cute. I’ll get the rest myself.
why: Combined 7.56 and the strongest thumb-stop of the 18 (8.1-8.2 from the art director and media buyer). Subtitles are read by reflex, gold glows on black, and it looks like nothing else in a cream jewellery feed. Woven Gold Hoops ads ran at 6.08% and 5.81%.
judge_fixes: All three judges: the H13 reverse shot (red cards and green baize, which echo the first ten's Teen patti; the solitaire-look ring, which reads as an engagement upgrade) is removed. A second band cannot be 'tighter' at 1.0x without upscaling, so the Story is one 2:1 still with both subtitle lines.

Fact checker: the reply is now a self-purchase line, '– Cute. I’ll get the rest myself.', not '– Cute. Where’s the rest?'. It fits the self-buying audience and still names 'the rest'. 'Cute.' stays light.
Subtitles kept at 50px or more, and the band kept at 540px tall.
The whisper was 26px with .24em tracking (about 914px, too close to the margins). It is now 24px with .2em (about 804px).

name: The rangoli's done. Come in.
idea: An exhibition poster for the whole collection, built on the rangoli-at-the-threshold photo. A rangoli is drawn at the door to welcome people in, so the poster says so: a small italic 'The rangoli’s done.' and then, enormous, 'Come in.' The info block reads like a show's: what is on and the range, and 'Admission free. Shipping too.'

photos.use: At exactly 1.0x, full width, as the lower part of both formats, with a hard edge to the paper band. FEED: the photo div is y404-1350, showing source y455-1401 (background-size 1080x1920, background-position 0 -455px inside the div). The bracelet (source x575-780, y553-772) lands at frame y≈502-721, 98px under the band edge. Rangoli dots and petals fill frame y≈1109-1350. STORY: the photo div is y700-1920, showing source y440-1660. The bracelet lands at frame y≈813-1032, and the rangoli flower fills y≈1420-1920.

palette: Band: cream #F3EDE4 with 2% paper grain. Ink #1A1614 (hairline at 45%, info at 75%). The aqua, pink and yellow of the rangoli and the pastel bracelet are the only colour.

KICKER: 'The rangoli’s done.' in CGI 500 44px, ink, x72, baseline 124. TITLE: 'Come in.' in CG 400 168px, x72, baseline 272 (cap top ≈166), about 565px wide, ending x≈637. INFO, as two lines right-aligned at x1008, baselines 236 and 272 (the second sits on the title's baseline): 'ADMISSION FREE.' / 'SHIPPING TOO.' in Jost 500 caps 22px, tracking .22em, ink 75% (about x711-1008, 74px clear of the title). HAIRLINE: 1px ink 45%, x72-1008, y312. BREADTH: 'Rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets. ₹599 to ₹2,399.' in CG 500 34px, ink, x72, baseline 362. PHOTO: y404-1350 as specified. No text on the photo.
story_layout: 1080x1920. BAND y0-700: cream with grain, hard edge at y700. LOGO: logo_ink.png 240px, x768-1008, y296-350. KICKER: CGI 500 50px, x72, baseline 344. TITLE: 'Come in.' in CG 400 176px, x72, baseline 540, about 593px wide (ends x≈665). BREADTH: CG 500 36px, ink, x72, baseline 642. PHOTO: y700-1920 as specified. All type between y296 and 650.
why: Combined 7.46 (media buyer 7.9). It turns a true cultural insight (a rangoli at the door means welcome) into a shop-all invitation, timed to the season without saying Diwali. H03 shows the 'most loved' Prism Rivière and descends from the 6.10% rangoli winner. The poster band with a hard edge looks printed and expensive.
judge_fixes: Art director: 'OPEN ALL NIGHT' cut (filler, and it reads as a physical store). 'ADMISSION FREE. SHIPPING TOO.' stays on its own, right-aligned.
Fact checker: the rangoli's meaning is now on the page with the kicker 'The rangoli’s done.', so 'Come in.' is not a generic line.

Media buyer and fact checker: the band is shortened to 404px and the info block moved to sit beside the title. The photo window grows to 946px, so the bracelet sits 98px under the edge (was about 80) and about 240px of rangoli shows (was about 240 with a cramped wrist).
'Free insured shipping' checked against the brief. No Diwali words.
Final-edit note: MI6 (A08) now uses H04 rather than H02, so A05 is the set's only Prism Rivière ad and both can run.

MIX ANY TWO: 10% OFF, APPLIED IN YOUR BAG
story_text: Nobody said they had to match.
MIX ANY TWO: 10% OFF, APPLIED IN YOUR BAG
why: Combined 7.46 (media buyer 8.1). It is built on the on-model listing photos behind the account's best purchase driver (Bestsellers carousel 5.73%, 43 purchases at 2.67x). The deliberate mismatch is graphic at phone size, and the Buy-2 offer becomes the twist rather than a shout. It is one of the set's two on-model ads and one of its curated multi-piece frames.
judge_fixes: Fact checker and art director: re-cropped from the source's top edge (y0, not y30) and shifted so the whole ear and hair at the gutter show, reading as a portrait pair. Panels trimmed to 660px so less bare neck shows (media buyer: about 80px less). Previewed: the ears mirror exactly about x540 and the hoops are level (y≈350-555 vs 350-545).
Art director and media buyer: breadth added after the offer ('Rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, from ₹599.'), and the offer now reads 'MIX ANY TWO', so the shop beyond earrings is implied.
Brief: the offer reads 'applied in your bag'. Only the product name 'Pearl Nugget Hoops' is used: no material claim, never 'freshwater'.
Prices checked against pool.json: ₹1,249 and ₹1,199.

name: Haiku, in three pieces
idea: A real 5-7-5 haiku set like printed verse on the calm blush wall above the ruby necklace and anaar: 'Rangoli, for ears. / Elaichi, around the wrist. / Anaar, at the throat.' Each line names a familiar Indian thing in the colour of one Naira piece (the rangoli studs, the elaichi-green bracelet, the anaar-red necklace pictured). A quiet note beside the bust says it is 'Three pieces of a much longer poem.'

photos.use: At exactly 1.0x in both formats. FEED: background-position 0 -330px (source y330-1680). The wall fills frame y0-410, the neck form starts at y≈410, the necklace sits at y≈520-890, the pomegranate on the right at y≈735-1090, and the arils at x≈495-850, y≈1085-1310.
